summary: Both backend and frontend tested for ClearDesk MVP. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass covering GET /api/dashboard shape (project, stats, insight, 4-item docket) and PATCH /api/docket/{id} (200, persistence across GET, 422 on missing status, error payload on unknown id). Frontend: Home dashboard loads with all required data-testids, stats, insight items, docket list, and correspondence detail. Clicking a docket item swaps the detail. Filters (All items / Urgent / Waiting on QS) correctly change the docket list count. Mark reviewed and Draft contract-backed reply successfully PATCH the item status and reflect in the list. Mobile viewport (390px): opens mobile nav, backdrop appears, close-mobile-nav button dismisses, no horizontal overflow.

minor.issue: Unknown item id returns HTTP 200 with {"error": ...} instead of 404. Should return 404 for proper client error handling.

Docket state is stored in a module-level SEED_DOCKET list mutated by PATCH; changes persist in-process but are lost on backend restart and are not isolated per client. Acceptable for demo scope but should be noted.

issues: Sidebar z-index (4) is higher than backdrop (3) and sidebar is opaque; tapping backdrop at its center falls on the sidebar. Real users can still close by tapping to the right of the sidebar, but consider making the backdrop overlap the sidebar visually or using an explicit tap target hint.

action_items: Optional: return HTTP 404 (not 200) from PATCH /api/docket/{id} when id is unknown.
Optional: persist docket state (Mongo) instead of mutating a module-level list so demo state survives backend restarts.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PATCH /docket/{item_id} returns 200 with error dict for missing ids — should be HTTPException(404).
SEED_DOCKET is module-level and mutated on PATCH — data leaks across clients and resets on reload.
App.js is a single dense file with no error/loading state on the axios PATCH; failures are silently swallowed. Consider try/catch and a toast.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created; used existing SEED_DOCKET (cor-1041/1045/1047/1048). One TEST_pytest StatusCheck row inserted by test_create_and_list_status.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and covers dashboard + docket PATCH + status check endpoints. It loads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env via python-dotenv. Frontend App.js is a single dense component: docket items have data-testid=docket-item-<id>, filters data-testid=filter-<slug>, actions data-testid=mark-reviewed-button and draft-reply-button. PATCH mutates SEED_DOCKET in-memory, so ordering of tests matters if extended.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bugs. One test-side quirk: playwright force click on the mobile backdrop hits the sidebar because both cover the tap point and sidebar has higher z-index; this is a test artifact, not an app defect.
